question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

12, 13, 14, 11, 16, 11, 12, 17, 15, 12

The mode of the data is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marks scored by 10 students:

12, 13, 14, 11, 16, 11, 12, 17, 15, 12

**Formula Used:**

Mode: The value that appears most frequently in a data set.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Frequency of each value:

12: 3 times

13: 1 time

14: 1 time

11: 2 times

16: 1 time

17: 1 time

15: 1 time

⇒ The value with the highest frequency is 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**
